archetypes.name: dyn-audit-reachability
archetypes.rationale: Step 8 reachability now depends on PR evidence and chained Step 9a1 fallback behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the audit_runs reachability changes for stale-bail and PR-evidence edge cases. Check that required-file scans and named guideline outcome scans agree on when Step 8 artifacts should be required. Pay special attention to gc-slimmed symlink handling and whether truly absent legacy artifacts remain informational. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
